caption: Lin v. Hudson City Savings Bank
citation_line: Lin v. Hudson City Savings Bank, No. 3:18-cv-15387, ECF No. 92 (D.N.J. Apr. 19, 2024)
headnote_district_ruling: Granted a renewed Rule 11 fee petition and ordered two previously declared vexatious litigants to pay $110,643.86 jointly and severally. The court used the lodestar as a guide and declined mitigation given repetitive bad-faith filings and deterrence needs.
qualification_rationale: A detailed sanctions-fee methodology with a substantial award, integrating authority, lodestar reasonableness, mitigation, and deterrence.
appellate_posture_note: Fee order followed dismissal of an earlier appeal in the underlying litigation; no substantive review of this order identified.
